title: feat: Home page enhancements - scroll animations, green corridors section, expanded AWS services
body:
## Summary

Enhanced the public Home page with scroll-triggered reveal animations, a new "Green Corridors" section linking to the route planner, and expanded AWS services in the footer marquee.

## Changes

### HomePage.tsx
- **IntersectionObserver scroll animations** — Elements fade in and slide up as they enter viewport (threshold 12%, rootMargin -40px)
- **New `#green-corridors` section** — CTA to `/routes` with illustrative route map showing Noida ? Central Delhi alternatives
  - Green corridor route highlighted in `#52674f`
  - Ring Road / Yamuna labels on map
  - Disclaimer: "No route can be guaranteed pollution-free"
- Refined hero grid with `landing-hero-grid` class for animation targeting

### PublicLayout.tsx
- **Desktop nav**: Added "Green corridors" link with animated pulse indicator pointing to `#green-corridors`
- **Mobile nav**: Bottom pill navigation with same 4 sections (Forecast, Routes, Companion, Care)
- **AWS services marquee**: Expanded from 4 to 16 services (DynamoDB, Lambda, Bedrock, Location Service, EventBridge, S3, CloudWatch, IAM, SNS, SQS, Step Functions, API Gateway, CloudTrail, ECS, Timestream, QuickSight)

### index.css
- `.reveal-on-scroll` / `.is-in-view` — fade + translateY animation (600ms ease-out)
- `.green-corridor-nav-link` — pulse animation, green accent color `#52674f`
- `.green-corridor-nav-indicator` — animated dot pulse
- Mobile responsive styles for new nav elements

## Verification

- **Build**: ? `npm run build` passes (493 kB JS, 61 kB CSS gzipped)
- **Lint**: ? `npm run lint` passes (0 errors)
- **Accessibility**: `prefers-reduced-motion` respected (animations disabled)

## Related
- PR #4: Premium light-theme refactor (merged)
- PR #5: Route planner with green corridor AQI scoring (open)
- PR #6: Layout cleanup (open)
- PR #7: Layout restoration (open)
